{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --time=00:45:00
#SBATCH --partition=full-node
#SBATCH --account=datascience
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=32

#!!! CONFIGURATION - START
export RANKS_PER_NODE=32
export acq_func="UCB"
export strategy="cl_max"
export timeout=1800
export random_state=42 
export problem="molecular"
export sync_val=0
export search="DBO"
#!!! CONFIGURATION - END

# activate Python environment
source ../../../build/activate-dhenv.sh
export PYTHONPATH=../../../build/dhenv/lib/python3.8/site-packages/:$PYTHONPATH

# start MPS daemon on each node
./launch-mps-service.sh

# For MPS Client Application
export CUDA_MPS_PIPE_DIRECTORY=/tmp/nvidia-mps 
export CUDA_MPS_LOG_DIRECTORY=/tmp/nvidia-log

if [[ "$sync_val" -eq 0 ]];
then
  export sync_str="async"
else
  export sync_str="sync"
fi

# CBO
# Using SLURM_NNODES instead of the Cobalt-specific COBALT_JOBSIZE
export log_dir="output/$problem-$search-$sync_str-$acq_func-$strategy-$SLURM_NNODES-$RANKS_PER_NODE-$timeout-$random_state";

# The --hostfile option is generally not needed with Slurm and mpirun,
# as mpirun can determine the node list from the Slurm environment.
echo "mpirun -x LD_LIBRARY_PATH -x PYTHONPATH -x PATH -n $(( $SLURM_NNODES * $RANKS_PER_NODE )) -N $RANKS_PER_NODE python -m scalbo.exp --problem $problem \
--search $search \
--sync $sync_val \
--timeout $timeout \
--acq-func $acq_func \
--strategy $strategy \
--random-state $random_state \
--log-dir $log_dir \
--verbose 1";

    --search $search \
    --sync $sync_val \
    --timeout $timeout \
    --acq-func $acq_func \
    --strategy $strategy \
    --random-state $random_state \
    --log-dir $log_dir \
    --verbose 1 
"
}

then
  export sync_str="async"
else
